testcase.name: isolated per-notification acknowledgement > acknowledges the owner notice with a server time without changing its content
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > replays after a lost response without rewriting the first read time
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > serializes concurrent acknowledgements into one read timestamp
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > keeps an already-read legacy record byte-for-byte unchanged
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > does not change another account's notification
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects an account switch even when both accounts exist
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > does not disclose or create missing notifications
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects unauthenticated requests
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {"userId":"qa-parent","notificationId":"bad/path"}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {"userId":"qa-parent","notificationId":".."}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {"userId":"qa-parent","notificationId":""}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {"userId":"bad/path","notificationId":"notification-read-qa-notice"}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {"userId":"qa-parent","notificationId":"notification-read-qa-notice","read":false}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > rejects invalid or extra request fields: {"userId":"qa-parent","notificationId":"notification-read-qa-notice","readAt":0}
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > touches only the explicitly selected notice, not older or newer rows
isolated per-notification acknowledgement > does not acknowledge a chat message or mutate its unread conversation counter
notification privacy and server-owned acknowledgement > allows only the addressed account to read and query its notices
notification privacy and server-owned acknowledgement > rejects direct owner writes, reverse reads, forged dates, deletion and creation
